TAKE OUR QUIZ

The Papago
Process

Not sure where to begin? At Papago Vans, we make the process simple, smooth, and actually enjoyable from first call to final keys.

Step 1: Reach Out to Start the Journey

Head to our Contact Us tab and submit the quick form. Jeremy will personally follow up with a call to go over your ideas, vision, and how we can bring your custom van to life.

Step 2: Get a Personalized Quote

Based on your preferences, we’ll craft a clear and detailed quote that includes all the features you’ve requested — exactly how you imagined your build.

Step 3: Van Sourcing Made Easy

No van? No problem. We’ve partnered with trusted brands like Mercedes, RAM, and Ford to help you secure a solid base vehicle. Already have one? You’re welcome to bring it in.

Step 4: Lock In Your Build Slot

Once your deposit is received, your spot in our build schedule is officially secured. From there, your dream van enters the pipeline.

Step 5: Design Meeting With Our Team

We’ll guide you through every detail of the design — layout, finishes, and features so the end result reflects your exact vision.

Step 6: Your Build Kicks Off

After your van arrives, our crew begins preparation whether that’s body upgrades, lift kits, or pre-build detailing — before moving into full construction.

Step 7: Take Delivery and Hit the Road

After the finishing touches, you’ll get a full walkthrough of your new van. We’ll show you how everything works so you feel confident and road-ready for your next adventure.
